subject: POC orchestration: kickoff, hands-on working session & load run coordination
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@cloudline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC orchestration: kickoff, hands-on working session & load run coordination

Hi Anita —

Great to be moving forward with Cloudline's POC. To get the POC off the ground we want to schedule two linked sessions:

1) 60m kickoff (stakeholders + success criteria, roles, access)
2) 3h hands-on working session (prompt review, routing policy workshop, and a short load run)

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue Apr 22, 10:00–14:00 (kickoff 10:00–11:00, working session 11:15–14:15)
- Wed Apr 23, 13:00–17:00 (kickoff 13:00–14:00, working session 14:15–17:15)

If those don't work, please tell us the times that do and the main Cloudline attendees we should expect. We will bring: model shortlist + fallback tier proposal, runbook draft, prompts spreadsheet, and a 30-minute load window (we'll need to reserve capacity).

I've attached a first-pass runbook and the prompts spreadsheet for pre-read. Can Karthik and Aditya weigh in on model selection and capacity needs? Marissa will coordinate the calendar invites once we agree.

Next steps: choose a window, confirm timezone for all attendees, and share any test accounts/whitelisted IPs we need before the load run.

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: poc-runbook-v1.pdf (runbook, 6 pages), prompts.xlsx (prompt matrix)

From: Anita Shah <anita.shah@cloudline.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cloudline POC <poc-team@cloudline.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Apr 2025 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC orchestration: kickoff, hands-on working session & load run coordination

Dylan —

Thanks for the clear outline. The team is excited. A few notes from our side:

- Our core team: me (Anita), Rajesh Patel (platform lead, EST), and Sofia Li (SRE, GMT+1 — London).
- Tue Apr 22 is challenging for Rajesh (back-to-back customer calls). Wed Apr 23 afternoon EST looks better but Sofia will prefer an afternoon-London friendly slot.
- We'd like the working session to include the load run at the end (so we can validate fallback behavior under stress).
- We've attached our internal POC requirements doc for your review (network/IP, test data, SLA expectations).

Proposed consolidated window (EST):
- Thu Apr 24, 13:00–17:30 EST (kickoff 13:00–14:00, working session 14:15–17:15) — that maps to 10:00–14:30 PDT. Does that work for you and your engineers?

Also: can you share a short model shortlist (1–3 variants) and suggested fallback tiers ahead of the session so Sofia and Rajesh can pre-read?

Thanks,
Anita
Head of Integrations
Cloudline AI

Attachment: cloudline_poc_requirements.docx (network and compliance checklist)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@cloudline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Apr 2025 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC orchestration: kickoff, hands-on working session & load run coordination

On Tue, Apr 15, 2025 at 10:05 AM Anita Shah <anita.shah@cloudline.ai> wrote:
> Dylan —
>
> Thanks for the clear outline. The team is excited. A few notes from our side:
> ...

Anita — the Thu Apr 24 window (10:00–14:30 PDT) works for our team. We'll treat the last 30–45 minutes of the working session as the load run (brief warmup, then 15–20 minute steady state).

Per your ask, attached is a model shortlist and our recommended fallback tiering for the workshop:
- model-shortlist.csv (recommended primary: redwood-optimized-7b-int8; fallbacks: redwood-optimized-4b-qat, small-llm-prod-3b)
- fallback tiers: Tier A (low-latency: redwood-optimized-7b-int8), Tier B (cost-saver: 4b-qat), Tier C (ultra-fallback: 3b)

Karthik / Aditya: can you confirm estimated GPU reservation (we expect a 20-concurrent-user load run; request: 4 x A100 / 8 x T4 equivalent for a 20-min window) and any pre-run checklist items?

I've provisioned a provisional calendar slot and Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890?pwd=runbook and added a draft calendar event (https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234). I'll send a firm invite once we confirm the final time.

Attachments: model-shortlist.csv, poc-runbook-v1.pdf (updated), prompts.xlsx

Best,
Dylan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@cloudline.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Apr 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC orchestration: kickoff, hands-on working session & load run coordination

Quick coordination note —

Sofia's London timezone means the Thu Apr 24 start at 10:00 PDT (13:00 EST / 18:00 BST) will be late for her; she asked if we can push the start by 2 hours to 12:00 PDT (15:00 EST / 20:00 BST). That would make the working session end ~16:15 PDT (19:15 EST / 00:15 BST) which may be tight for Sofia.

Options:
- Keep Thu Apr 24 10:00 PDT (preferred for our infra team) and have Sofia join for kickoff + first 90m of the workshop, then handoff; or
- Move to Fri Apr 25 12:00–16:30 PDT (15:00–19:30 EST) to make it slightly more London-friendly.

On the infra side (Aditya / Karthik): we recommend reserving Dedicated capacity for the load run window to ensure stable latency and to test fallback routing. Attached is a concise loadtest plan (steps and metrics). Please confirm capacity reservation by EOD Thu Apr 17 so we can update the Docusign/ops checklist.

Marissa
Program Manager, Customer POCs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: loadtest-plan.md (run steps, metrics, rollback criteria)

From: Anita Shah <anita.shah@cloudline.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cloudline POC <poc-team@cloudline.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Apr 2025 16:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC orchestration: kickoff, hands-on working session & load run coordination

Thanks everyone — final confirmation from Cloudline:

- We'll go with Fri Apr 25, 15:00–19:30 EST (12:00–16:30 PDT) to accommodate Sofia.
- Attendees: Anita Shah, Rajesh Patel (platform), Sofia Li (SRE), and a short list of engineers (poc-team@cloudline.ai).
- We approve the model shortlist and agree to reserve capacity for the 20-minute steady-state load run at the end of the session.
- Please send a run-of-show and final checklist (network whitelist, service account, and security questionnaire) by Tue Apr 22 so our SREs can review ahead of time.

I'll sign the standard mutual action plan and send the countersigned DocuSign link once we receive the run-of-show.

Cheers,
Anita
Head of Integrations
Cloudline AI
